answer: A TEE-gated elapsed-time admission lottery. Each enclave draws a wait from an on-chain randomness beacon and sleeps it out; its signed timer leans on a drift-audited quartz oscillator, so parallel fakes share one clock; fastest attestations fill the epoch's slots — a flat mesa seating exactly N rigs; two enclaves claiming overlapping windows from one board both void out. Each fake costs ~$180 attested mini-PC, $65 TPM, 40 min provisioning — 100 sybils: $24,500 and 66 bench-hours. Like permits to climb a mesa: rangers fingerprint hands, so one pair can't summit two routes at once.
